argv:
تا حالا شده بعد از یه قرار خوب، گوشی دستت باشه و ندونی الان پیام بدی یا صبر کنی؟

پژوهشگرا دقیقاً همین سؤال رو آزمایش کردن: بعد از قرار اول، چه زمانی برای فرستادن اولین پیام بهتره؟

در این مطالعه، ۵۴۳ نفر تصور کردند یک قرار اول داشتند و بعد، طرف مقابل یا بلافاصله پیام می‌داد، یا صبح روز بعد، یا دو روز بعد.

جالب‌ترین نتیجه این بود که بیشترین تمایل به ادامه رابطه وقتی دیده شد که پیام صبح روز بعد می‌رسید.

پیام فوری، علاقه رو واضح‌تر نشون می‌داد، اما فرستنده کمی نیازمندتر به نظر می‌رسید. از اون طرف، دو روز صبر کردن هم کمکی نکرد؛ افراد احساس شیمی و انگیزه کمتری برای ادامه ارتباط داشتند و طرف مقابل رو کمتر قابل‌اعتماد می‌دیدند.

یعنی حداقل در این آزمایش، «دیر پیام بده تا مشتاق به نظر نرسی» استراتژی خیلی خوبی نبود.

حالا تو بگو: بعد از قرار اول، همون شب پیام می‌دی، فردا صبح یا صبر می‌کنی؟
prepare_inputs: idea + script artifacts from approved copy
interphase: read alignment contracts and run alignment-plan
plan_scenes_moments: scene plan, hook selection, moments

کاربر در تصمیم قلاب (plan_scenes_moments) صریحاً انتخاب کرد که جملهٔ اول نریشن به‌عنوان قلاب او ثبت شود، چون اثبات اول در این محتوا دیرتر از سقف ۶ ثانیه گفته می‌شود.

Frame review of the selected clips measured every hard region against the declared band: ev-6, ev-12 and ev-13 keep the upper band clear (plain wall / plain dark background) while the subject occupies the centre, so the moment belongs in the upper band, not the centre. The plan's declared centre_band was written before any footage existed.

Frame review of the selected clips measured every hard region against the declared band: ev-6, ev-12 and ev-13 keep the upper band clear (plain wall / plain dark background) while the subject occupies the centre, so the moment belongs in the upper band. The plan declared centre_band before any footage existed.

Reviewed start/middle/end: the hand-held phone spans roughly x3-7, y1-7 of the frame, so it occupies the declared upper band and every other serviceable band (left/right columns are only 0.33 wide and lower_band is the reserved caption strip). Film Type would refuse the opening moment here. The alternate framing query asks for the plain wall above the hand instead.

Reviewed start/middle/end: a woman drinking from a mug beside a laptop at a table. No phone is in frame anywhere in the selected window, so shows_subject is false and the beat ('a person texting at a table') is not served.

Reviewed start/middle/end: a nightclub dance floor lit magenta with one person filming on a phone. The beat needs many people imagining a first date; a party crowd at night also contradicts the plan's street-daytime environment. Re-search with the sky-framed alternate.

Reviewed start/middle/end: hands fill x1-9, y1-9 with a phone held close, occupying the declared upper band and every other serviceable band. Semantically strong, but no legal type region exists on it, so it cannot carry the moment it is planned for.

Reviewed start/middle/end: a man calmly drinking from a cup in a bright daytime cafe with a phone lying flat on the table. The beat is an anxious person waiting on a reply, and affect_match is false: nothing in the frame reads as neediness or waiting.

Reviewed start/middle/end: a phone lying FACE UP on a sheet of paper reading 'I NEED A HOLIDAY'. The beat needs a phone lying face down on a plain surface; the on-screen English text is unrelated to the narration and would read behind a Persian moment.

Reviewed start/middle/end: one man alone at a table with a phone and a cup in a bright room. The beat needs two people sitting apart, and a single subject cannot carry the distance/coldness of the finding.

Reviewed start/middle/end: the hand-held phone starts at about three tenths down the frame and spans the full width, so its reviewed hard region occupies the declared upper band and every other serviceable band. The clip is semantically right but has no legal type region, so it cannot carry the closing moment.

Footage review found three events whose selected clip fills every serviceable type band: ev-1 (opening hook carrier), ev-8 and ev-13. A hand-held phone at close range occupies the declared band and both columns, so no Persian moment can be placed. The plan asked for close-ups where the hook needs a wide shot with a plain wall or surface carrying the type.

Measured against the clips actually on disk: ev-8's retry clip places the phone's top edge on the upper-band boundary, so its moment moves to ev-9, whose subject sits entirely below 0.4 of the frame. ev-10's clip is a lone phone on a plain table under a plain tiled wall, so the moment belongs in the upper band rather than the centre the phone occupies.

Reviewed geometry: ev-12's subject head sits inside the upper third, so its declared band is genuinely occupied and no serviceable alternative exists. The moment moves to ev-11, whose two figures sit below four tenths of the frame with a plain wall above; its annotation is corrected to match the face box already recorded there.
User approved the ev-1 opening-hook field fix

moment-3 (543 people) has no measured placement on shot-4: the selected crowd clip's backlit silhouette crosses the upper band at every window of the source, and its one visible face blocks the centre column.
